_comment_dependency_order: setup -> bronze -> silver -> gold -> validation -> export.
Each task's depends_on means Databricks Workflows will NOT start it
until the upstream task finishes SUCCESSFULLY. A failure anywhere in
the chain stops all downstream tasks automatically -- validation is
guaranteed to run before export, and export is guaranteed to run only
if validation passed (05_validation.py raises on any failed check).
